mechanics.claim: The shield's effects are gained at the start of the cast time, and Seraphine can move during the cast time.
mechanics.quote: ''Surround Sound's'' effects are gained at the start of the cast time.

mechanics.claim: The heal pulse only occurs if Seraphine already had a shield active when she cast the ability, and it happens after the shield duration ends.
mechanics.quote: If '''Seraphine''' already had a {{tip|shield}} at the time of cast, ''Surround Sound'' will pulse after the duration, {{tip|heal|healing}} herself and nearby allied champions.

mechanics.claim: Recasting during the pulse's delay refreshes the delay instead of stacking a new pulse immediately.
mechanics.quote: Casting ''Surround Sound'' again during the pulse's delay refreshes the delay.

mechanics.claim: The heal is canceled if Seraphine dies before it resolves.
mechanics.quote: The heal will be canceled and the indicator will disappear upon '''Seraphine''' dying.

mechanics.claim: The shield and bonus movement speed can stack up to 2 times.
mechanics.quote: ''Surround Sound's shield and {{as|'''bonus''' movement speed}} can stack up to 2 times.
